title: Domina's Dice (Game 1)
description: Do you wanna play a game? I love games, I bet you do too. How about a dance with destiny? — A roll of the dice. Where your fate lies solely in my hands. Hanging on every word I say, on each snap of my fingers. Where every number I count up is a tease. And every number I count down a test. Where you must follow MY rules at all times, and only I may break them. Do you think you'd make it to the end? Why not test yourself and see if you can beat "Domina's Dice"!
author: Mistress Shibby
